subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept client-capability-gated tool availability plus a bundled Canvas `show_widget` web-chat widget tool as the supported direction for this issue?
rationale: The work creates a plugin-visible tool API and a model-authored markup sandbox boundary, so automation cannot safely approve the product/API and security policy from source evidence alone.

options.title: Review The Linked Implementation PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate path, fixing any blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

options.title: Redesign The Capability API First
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the PR until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Reject Bundled Widget Support
options.body: Close the implementation path and route widget experimentation to external plugins or ClawHub until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Review The Linked Implementation PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate path, fixing any blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the issue and linked implementation PR and has the strongest current history signal across the affected gateway, Canvas, and Control UI surfaces.
